limitations: Single machine; synthetic held-out microbenchmarks, not sampled production traffic.
Heuristic, conservative simple and conservative planner share the final binary; no released-stock comparison.
Only seven independent blocks; p95 at n7 is the sample maximum.
Tiny outputs arrive within one speculative batch: raw client decode TPS is invalid for them and omitted from CSV.
Code native output counter includes runtime-specific boundaries; do not compare to other runtimes without aligning definitions.
Identical hard memory budgets, not identical occupied RAM.
Chooser timing excludes LCP observation; request E2E includes it.
No global eviction opportunity-cost objective or memory-budget sweep.
The comparison identifies the combined planner effect, not the value of each planner feature.
